labels: The Oxford shirt cloth shows a small basket-like weave, while the separately placed Oxford shoes have closed lacing at their vamps.; 옥스퍼드 셔츠 천에는 작은 바스켓 같은 조직이 보이고 별도로 놓인 옥스퍼드 구두의 발등에는 닫힌 끈 여밈이 있다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: The Oxford shirt cloth shows a small basket-like weave, while the separately placed Oxford shoes have closed lacing at their vamps.
